fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on local public affairs in Greater Miami, including criticism of Florida Power & Light Company’s electric rates and alleged political influence; discussion of Miami city budget cuts affecting police and other municipal employees; and analysis of the City of Miami’s agreement with the Miami Beach Railway Company regarding bus operations and profit-sharing. Also includes items on tourism and entertainment in Miami Beach/Coral Gables, letters to the editor about policing and civic conditions, and reporting/commentary related to Prohibition-era enforcement involving Coast Guard boat 248 and liquor seizures.
